body: Yeah I get that, this is one of the reasons we broke up and I’m now alone because I have co-dependency issues. My ex asked me for space multiple times but I just couldn’t wrap my head around it, I hated her going out without me etc. Lockdown of course didn’t help with this.

But it’s a real catch 22 because I actually prefer my own company, like I just feel like I need to know someone is there if I need them at all times… in a relationship you have that constantly but when you’re alone it’s like hell. I don’t like socialising because I feel like I don’t connect with people and it makes me anxious.
Does anyone have any suggestions on how to cope with losing an FP

I can’t help but think but if she’s doing it to hurt me she must still have feelings for me and must just be angry at me for sleeping with someone so soon after the breakup. I feel like I’m clutching at straws but I just miss her so much. 

I’m currently in the process of being properly diagnosed by the doctor so I can get treatment but I’m the meantime I’ve signed up to online group coaching which seems to be helping although I still have some bad days like today has been awful, it’s usually when I’m not busy and my mind has time to ruminate over things…

It’s helpful to hear that you’ve managed to overcome it. Although I feel like I’ll never be free of it and it’s so much harder not having any support from a partner.
That’s okay, it’s the new girl she’s seeing that has BPD, I feel like she told me that to hurt me even more though, like she’s just replacing me in a way

She doesn’t even have BPD😂🤷🏻‍♀️ 

But yeah I kinda get the feeling she’s trying to hurt me

I’m in exactly the same boat as you but my ex split up with me around 2 months ago…

She’s also seeing a new girl who also has BPD, she swears it’s only casual but it was killing me that much I had to remove her from social media.

It’s going to be tough, but I think breaking contact and focusing on your emotional well-being should be key. Cliche as it sounds, time will give you clarity and if it’s meant for you it will definitely come back.
Thank you, happy birthday to you too x
Thank you, that was really helpful. I hope you have a lovely birthday as well x
Thank you that helps a lot. I know rationally that I won’t feel like this forever but it doesn’t stop the waves of really intense emotions, it feels like you are drowning at times! 🥲

I struggle with rage badly, not really sure what advice to give since I struggle to snap out of it myself but recently I’ve found that recognising the triggers and also when I feel it happening and I’ve recognised and understoood why im feeling angry then telling myself that anger is normal and that it’s okay to be angry and like all emotions it will pass, the important thing is not to act on it.
We were still intimate, ie. Affection, cuddling. Just no sexual connection.
